headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange KSE-100 Index Slips Nearly 200 Points
summary: The benchmark KSE-100 Index at the Pakistan Stock Exchange shed nearly 200 points in early trading, hovering at 177,895.43.
why: Stock exchange benchmark movements reflect investor sentiment across key sectors including commercial banks and automobile assemblers in Pakistan.

impacts.name: KSE-100 Index
impacts.why: Tracks aggregate capitalization changes on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Selling pressure across key sectors including automobile assemblers, cement, and commercial banks drove the index down.
